title: [BUG]UnicodeDecodeError: 'gbk' codec can't decode byte 0xac in position 102: illegal multibyte sequence
description: When loading a variable from the yaml environment, the crewai library tries to load it in gbk encoding as soon as Chinese is present in it, but my yaml file is utf-8. This test reproduces the bug by creating a YAML file with Chinese characters and attempting to load it.
